# Identity: organizations, members, API keys

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/api_reference.py from contracts/openapi; do not edit. -->

Base path: `https://<gateway>/identity`. Every call needs an API key or a Studio session (see [Authentication](index.md#authentication)). Request and response fields are in the OpenAPI document, `contracts/openapi/identity.json`.

| Method | Path | What it does | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/api-keys` | List Keys |  | 200 list of `ApiKeyOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/api-keys` | Create Key | `ApiKeyIn` | 201 `ApiKeyCreated` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/api-keys/{key_id}` | Revoke Key |  | 204 |
| `GET` | `/v1/groups` | List Groups |  | 200 list of `GroupOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/groups` | Create Group | `GroupIn` | 201 `GroupOut` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/groups/{group_id}` | Delete Group |  | 204 |
| `PUT` | `/v1/groups/{group_id}/members/{member_id}` | Add Group Member |  | 204 |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/groups/{group_id}/members/{member_id}` | Remove Group Member |  | 204 |
| `GET` | `/v1/licence` | The installation's licence, for administrators. |  | 200 `LicenceOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/members` | List Members |  | 200 list of `MemberOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/members` | Invite Member | `MemberInvite` | 201 `MemberOut` |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/members/{member_id}` | Update Member | `MemberPatch` | 200 `MemberOut` |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/members/{member_id}` | Remove Member |  | 204 |
| `GET` | `/v1/session/memberships` | Tenants the signed-in user belongs to (pending invites to a verified email are accepted). |  | 200 list of `SessionMembership` |
| `POST` | `/v1/session/tenants` | Self-serve tenant creation for Keycloak/Auth0/OIDC sign-ups. | `TenantCreate` | 201 `TenantOut` |
| `GET` | `/v1/tenant` | Get Tenant |  | 200 `TenantOut` |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/tenant` | Patch Tenant | `TenantPatch` | 200 `TenantOut` |
